cause_quote: The new `refreshFailed` getter included `catalog.providerOutcomes?.some((outcome) => outcome.status !== "ready")`, so an `auth-rejected` outcome alone set the refresh-failure flag.
user_saw: With a signed-out Qwen CLI installed, users saw a persistent retry warning on the Control UI Automations page.
summary: The fix reserves the shared catalog refresh warning for unavailable providers and recorded acquisition errors while preserving sign-in guidance and incomplete inventory status.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent: `auth-rejected` was already a distinct provider outcome when #142165 added the catalog-wide flag, and the flag counted that outcome as a refresh failure from its first version. #156278 later added structured ACP sign-in outcomes and repeated the same classification in the native inventory check, carrying the defect into the reported Qwen case.
